definition.text: Legally valid designation of the natural or judicial person responsible for the design, production, packaging and labeling of the product.
Short description of the product (short text).
2nd level of a 3-level product group hierarchy.
Characteristic to differentiate between different products of a product family or special variants.
Unique combination of numbers and letters used to identify the device once it has been manufactured.
Combination of numbers and letters used to identify a batch of products.
Country where the product was manufactured (2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code).
Year as completion date of object.
Version of the hardware supplied with the device.
Version of the software used by the firmware or control code of a device.
Sum of all greenhouse gas emissions of a product according to ISO 14067 in kg CO2 equivalent per declared unit.
Direct GHG emissions from sources owned or controlled by the reporting organisation (Scope 1).
Indirect GHG emissions from the generation of purchased energy (Scope 2).
All other indirect GHG emissions in the value chain not included in Scope 2 (Scope 3).
Standard or methodology used to calculate the product carbon footprint (e.g. ISO 14040, ISO 14067, GHG Protocol).
Declared unit for which the PCF was calculated (e.g. per kg, per piece, per kWh).
Total Global Warming Potential (GWP) expressed in kg CO2 equivalent per functional unit.
Life Cycle Assessment standard applied (e.g. EN 15804, ISO 14040/14044).
URL link to the published Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) document.
Total amount of electrical charge a battery can store, measured in Ampere-hours.
Available capacity of a battery expressed as a percentage of its rated capacity.
Expected number of complete charge/discharge cycles a battery can deliver before falling below 80% rated capacity.
Expected calendar service life of the battery in years under standard operating conditions.
Active material used in the battery cathode (e.g. LFP, NMC, NCA, LCO).
Active material used in the battery anode (e.g. graphite, silicon, lithium metal).
Material or type of electrolyte used in the battery cell.
Nominal voltage of the battery pack under standard operating conditions.
Maximum permissible charging voltage that the battery cell or pack can safely withstand.
Total energy deliverable by the battery under specified conditions, expressed in kilowatt-hours.
Gravimetric energy density of the battery expressed in watt-hours per kilogram.
Volumetric energy density of the battery expressed in watt-hours per litre.
Percentage of secondary (recycled) cobalt content in active battery material.
Percentage of secondary (recycled) lithium content in active battery material.
Percentage of secondary (recycled) nickel content in active battery material.
Percentage of secondary (recycled) lead content in active battery material.
Total weight of the battery pack including housing and connectors.
Recommended extinguishing agent to be used in case of fire involving this battery.
Index score (0–10) per applicable EU methodology indicating ease of disassembly and repair.
Index score (0–10) indicating operational durability and expected product lifespan.
Percentage of the product (by mass) that can be recovered and recycled at end of life.
Expected service life of the product under normal conditions of use, expressed in years.
Indicates whether the product has been designed to enable easy disassembly for repair, reuse or recycling.
URL to a published deconstruction or disassembly manual for this product.
Percentage of recycled plastic content in the product by total plastic weight.
Percentage of packaging material sourced from post-consumer recycled material.
Type of material used for product packaging (e.g. cardboard, glass, PET, PP).
Designation of the raw material or substance used in the product composition.
Mass percentage of a specific material in the overall product composition.
Indicates whether the product contains Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) listed under REACH above 0.1% w/w.
Concentration of identified Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) in the article (% w/w).
GHS/CLP hazard classification categories applicable to this product or substance.
URL to the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) document compliant with REACH Regulation Annex II.
List of declared allergens present in the product as required by applicable regulation.
Full list of ingredients or components present in the product (INCI or CAS nomenclature).
Type of textile fiber used in the product (e.g. Organic Cotton, Recycled Polyester, Wool).
Proportion of a specific fiber type in the product's total fiber composition by weight.
Instructions for safe use, washing, ironing and drying of the textile product.
Product size designation following applicable standard (ISO, EU, US, or custom).
Thermal conductivity of the material — rate at which heat is transferred through a unit thickness.
Ultimate compressive strength of the material when subjected to a uniaxial compressive load.
Maximum stress a material can withstand when being stretched or pulled before breaking.
Fire behaviour classification of the construction product according to EN 13501-1.
Mass per unit volume of the material or product in kilograms per cubic metre.
External length of the product or component as manufactured.
External width of the product or component as manufactured.
External thickness of the product or component as manufactured.
Electrical power consumed by the product in standby (off-mode) operation.
Expected operating hours on internal battery under typical load conditions.
EU energy efficiency class label (A+++ to G) of the product.
Estimated annual energy consumption under standard representative usage conditions.
Instructions for proper disposal or take-back of electronic waste under the WEEE Directive.
Indicates whether the product bears CE marking as required by applicable EU directives.
URL or reference to the EU Declaration of Conformity (DoC) document.
Reference number of the EU Declaration of Performance (DoP) for construction products.
Name or designation of the third-party compliance certificate or standard verification.
Name of the notified body, certification authority or conformity assessment body issuing the certificate.
Unique reference number assigned to the certificate by the issuing body.
Expiry date of the compliance certificate (ISO 8601 date format).
Legal or operational name of the manufacturing or processing facility.
Physical address or geographic location of the facility (city, country).
Primary manufacturing or processing activity performed at the facility.
Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number of the facility operator.
SHA-256 cryptographic hash of the traceability document for integrity verification.
Publicly accessible URL to the referenced traceability or sourcing document.
Percentage by weight of post-consumer scrap metal used in the product production.
Structural steel tensile strength class designation (e.g. S235JR, S355JR per EN 10025).
Carbon dioxide equivalent emissions intensity per tonne of steel or metal produced.
Standard metallurgical classification of the metal product (e.g. Carbon Structural Steel).
Percentage of post-consumer recycled scrap used in aluminium or metal production.
Primary electricity source used in the smelting process (e.g. hydro, wind, grid).
Energy consumed per kilogram of metal produced during the smelting or rolling process.
